user.title: Casa Mia Intercom
user.description: A call for each doorbell (any device with a doorbell event and a camera), shared by every screen: a Call sensor and an End call button on a device per doorbell. Talking into a doorbell's camera answers its call, and nobody else can talk until it ends. Uses the Casa Mia integration's connection to the app.

patch_failed.description: Casa Mia Intercom couldn't patch Home Assistant, so doorbell calls aren't kept and anyone can talk at once. Cameras are unaffected. Reason: {reason}. Check the log for details; a Home Assistant update may have changed its go2rtc integration.
